entrare.inviata.testo: You asked to join {istanza}. It is now up to whoever runs the instance: once they approve you, you can sign in with the username and password you just chose.
entrare.messaggio.aiuto: Read by whoever decides whether to let you in.

errori.backup_not_configured: Set a public backup key first.
errori.backup_not_found: There is no key backup for this account.
errori.backup_private_key_offered: This is the PRIVATE key. The instance only needs the public one: that is what stops it from reading its own backups.
errori.backup_public_key_invalid: The public backup key must start with «age1».
errori.backup_settings_from_environment: These backups are set by environment variables: change them in the container's configuration.
errori.bio_troppo_lunga: The description can be at most {massimo} characters.
errori.cannot_message_self: You cannot start a conversation with yourself.
errori.casa_che_ordina_non_raggiungibile: The home that manages this conversation is not answering: members cannot be added or removed right now.
errori.chiave_di_questa_istanza: This is this instance's own key: an instance does not connect to itself.
errori.chiave_mancante: The other instance's public key is needed.
errori.commento_non_inviato: The comment did not arrive: that home did not answer, or cannot receive it yet.
errori.commento_remoto: This comment lives in another home: you cannot do this from here.
errori.conflict: Someone else changed the same thing at the same moment. Refresh and try again.
errori.cuore_non_arrivato: The heart did not arrive: that home did not answer, or cannot receive it yet.
errori.data_not_durable: This instance's data would not survive an update. Mount a folder or a named volume on the data directory, then try again: you will only configure it once.
errori.device_not_approved: This device cannot do that until it has been approved itself.
errori.device_not_registered: This device has no key yet: sign out and back in from a secure connection.
errori.empty_comment: A comment needs something in it.
errori.empty_post: A post needs something in it.
errori.follow_inesistente: You are not following this person.
errori.follower_inesistente: This person does not follow you.
errori.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errori.instance_already_configured: This instance has already been configured.
errori.internal_error: Something went wrong on the instance. Try again in a moment.
errori.invalid_credentials: Username or password is not valid.
errori.invalid_cursor: This page can no longer be loaded. Refresh and try again.
errori.invalid_image: This file is not a readable image.
errori.invalid_instance_name: The instance name cannot be empty.
errori.invalid_invite: This invite is not valid: it may have expired, been used already or been withdrawn.
errori.invalid_recovery_code: Username or recovery code is not valid.
errori.invalid_setup_token: This code is not valid. It is the one printed in the instance console, and it changes at every restart.
errori.invite_no_longer_valid: The invite behind this request is no longer valid.
errori.istanza_bloccata: This instance is blocked. Unblock it before connecting.
errori.istanza_non_raggiungibile: This person's home is not answering. Try again later.
errori.join_request_already_decided: This request has already been decided.
errori.lingua_sconosciuta: This language is not available on this instance.
errori.media_already_used: This image is already used somewhere else.
errori.media_missing: This image is no longer available.
errori.media_quota_exceeded: You have used up your space for images. Delete some older posts.
errori.media_too_large: The image is larger than this instance allows.
errori.media_too_many_pixels: The image has too many pixels to be processed.
errori.messaggio_inesistente: You have no message with this name.
errori.nessun_archivio: This conversation has no archive yet.
errori.nessun_punto_di_rientro: This conversation has no point to re-enter from yet.
errori.nessuna_richiesta: There is no connection request from this instance.
errori.network_probe_from_environment: The network setting comes from ESTIA_NETWORK_PROBE: a change made here would only last until the next restart, so it cannot be changed here.
errori.no_device_available: This person has no device ready for messages yet: it will have one as soon as they open ESTIA.
errori.nome_troppo_lungo: The display name can be at most {massimo} characters.
errori.nome_vuoto: The display name cannot be empty.
errori.non_membro: You are not a member of this conversation.
errori.not_found: What you are looking for is not here.
errori.rete_non_attiva: This instance is not on the network, and what you asked for is in another home.
errori.rete_non_disponibile: This instance does not talk to other instances yet.

errori.richiesta_incompleta: Say who to follow, and on which instance.
errori.richiesta_troppo_grande: What you sent is too large for this instance.
errori.solo_autore: Only the person who wrote this can do it.
errori.solo_moderazione: Only the moderators of this instance can do this.
errori.troppe_richieste: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errori.unsupported_media_type: JPEG, PNG and WebP images are accepted.
errori.username_taken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
recupero.codice.aiuto: Capitals, lowercase and dashes don't matter: type it as you copied it.
recupero.fatto.sessioni.one: To be safe, the open session has been closed: you will need to sign in again on that device.
recupero.fatto.sessioni.other: To be safe, all {n} open sessions have been closed: you will need to sign in again on every device.
recupero.fatto.testo: The code you used is now spent. This is its replacement, and again this is the only time it is shown.
recupero.intro: It is the code you were shown when the instance was created, or after the last recovery.
recupero.titolo: Get back in with the recovery code
ripristino.conseguenza: Signing in without them, this browser makes a key of its own: you rejoin the conversations anyway, but the previous browser stays in them as one more of your devices. Putting the key back replaces it instead. The copy is not deleted.
ripristino.cronologia: The history comes back as soon as another person in each conversation opens it again: by opening it, they hand you back the key to read it.
ripristino.errore: This passphrase does not open the copy. Try again.
ripristino.salta: Sign in without them, for now
ripristino.testo: The keys for private messages are made in the browser and stay there, so this one — new, or emptied — does not have yours. There is a copy on the instance, though: your passphrase opens it and puts the same key back here, so you rejoin your conversations in place of the previous browser.
ripristino.titolo: Your keys are not on this browser
setup.account.intro: You are the first person in this instance, and the one who runs it.
setup.account.utente_aiuto: Lowercase, no spaces. It cannot be changed: it is the name you will be known by here and on the other instances.
setup.codice.backup: Already have a backup to restore?
setup.codice.intro: You find it printed in the instance console when it starts. It does not end up in the logs, and a new one is printed at every restart.
setup.codice_scaduto: The code is no longer valid: the instance restarted and printed a new one. Look at the console again and type it in — I kept the rest.
setup.dati.anonimo: {forte} Docker created it by itself because nobody asked for one, and only carries it along when it is {compose} that recreates the container. {avviso}: accounts, content, photos and the private key, which cannot be replaced.
setup.dati.anonimo_avviso: If you update from the NAS panel, the instance starts empty every time
setup.dati.anonimo_forte: This instance's data is on an anonymous volume.
setup.dati.effimero: {forte} They disappear at the first update of the image — all of them, including the private key that makes the instance recognisable to its members, which cannot be replaced.
setup.dati.effimero_forte: This instance's data is inside the container.
setup.dati.esisteva.dopo: There is one for every time the instance started from scratch. The most recent is the last configuration you were using; you put it back by copying it into the folder you will mount above, and the installation guide explains it step by step. {forte} until you have checked that the instance is back with your things inside.
setup.dati.esisteva.forte: the old data is almost certainly still on the machine
setup.dati.esisteva.testo: Then {forte}: the volume that held it was not deleted, it was only left with nobody using it. From a terminal on the machine, this lists the volumes holding an ESTIA database, with the date of the last write:
setup.dati.hai_backup: Do you have a backup to restore?
setup.dati.nas: {forte}: stop the container, open it for editing and, in the volumes (or folders) section, add a line pointing a folder of yours — for example {esempio} — to the path {data} inside the container. Then restart it.
setup.dati.non_ti_lascio: I won't let you set it up like this. There is nothing inside yet, so fixing it takes five minutes; later it would cost everything this community will have put into it.
setup.dati.prova: If instead you are only having a look at ESTIA and will throw it all away in ten minutes, start the container with {variabile} and this screen will let you through.
setup.dati.terminale: {forte}: use the {file} file from the installation guide, which declares a named volume. It is also how updates stop asking you anything.
setup.dati.titolo: First, let's give the data a home
setup.istanza.descrizione_aiuto: Anyone who receives an invite will see it, before asking to join.
setup.istanza.descrizione_esempio: The feed of the people living on Elm Street.
setup.istanza.intro: Its members see the name, and so does anyone who receives an invite, before asking to join.
setup.istanza.titolo: Let's give this instance a name
setup.recupero.dove: Copy it on paper, into a password manager, onto a USB stick — wherever you like, as long as it is not only on this computer. If you lose the code {e} the password, nobody can recover the instance any more.
setup.recupero.scritto: I have written it somewhere safe
setup.recupero.testo: It is your instance's recovery code. It gets you back in if you forget your password, and this is {forte} it is shown: the instance keeps only a fingerprint of it, and cannot show it to you again.
setup.riepilogo.intro: This is where the instance and its administrator come into being. It is the last screen before anything exists.
setup.ripristino.avviso: {forte} To protect the community's data even in case of theft or compromise, the instance only keeps the public key it writes backups with. Only you have the private key: it must never be entered in the browser or travel over HTTP (ADR 0013 and ADR 0016).
setup.ripristino.avviso_forte: Backups are encrypted and the private key does not go through the browser.
